# Strategy

What Tillstack is, what it makes and its parts are in [self.md](./self.md); this page says why it exists, who it serves and how it wins.

## Why it exists

Small shops lose sales at the till when checkout is slow or breaks. Tillstack gives them a checkout that just works.

## Who it serves

Independent shops that sell online and in person.

## How it wins

- Payments run on Stripe, so its fees and its outages are ours.
- It is simpler than an alternative like Cartwell, which shops leave when it gets in their way.

## Values

- What lies outside it is read in daily totals and public pages, never in a shopper's own data.
